property_summary: For all callers, calling sudicideAnyone() on the reference contract does not allow a non-owner to destroy the contract (only the smartfix_owner can cause selfdestruct); the mutant removes that check so some caller address (not equal to smartfix_owner) will be able to successfully selfdestruct and make address(c).balance zero / revert behavior differ.
change_summary: Remove the require check so anyone can call and trigger selfdestruct, changing who can cause contract destruction.
